explanation: `h.pull M` is `(M.subgroupOf Γ).map h.emb`, where `Γ = F4.reeGamma h.K h.a`. So the statement is: if `M ≤ normalizer M'`, then `map emb (comap Γ.subtype M) ≤ normalizer (map emb (comap Γ.subtype M'))`. I found no single Mathlib lemma for this. In `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Basic.lean`, `Subgroup.le_normalizer_comap` says `(normalizer H).comap f ≤ normalizer (H.comap f)`. `Subgroup.le_normalizer_map` says `(normalizer H).map f ≤ normalizer (H.map f)`. Together with `map_mono` and `comap_mono`, these two give a one-line proof: `(Subgroup.map_mono ((Subgroup.comap_mono hM).trans (Subgroup.le_normalizer_comap _))).trans (Subgroup.le_normalizer_map _)`. That is a composition of two different Mathlib lemmas, not an instantiation of one declaration. I also looked for `subgroupOf_normalizer_eq`, `comap_normalizer_eq_of_le_range` and `map_normalizer_eq_of_bijective`. None states the combined subgroupOf-then-map result. So I did not find a single matching declaration.
